hashMethod: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(package-lock.json)); insensitive to whitespace and line endings
scope: All non-root lockfile package paths, including peer and platform-optional development packages
licenseEvidence: Standard licenses come from exact locked package metadata. Custom signing licenses were read from all ten integrity-verified registry tarballs; memorystream was resolved from its installed LICENSE and legacy licenses metadata. Standard off-platform tarball license texts were not individually downloaded.
